subject: reasoning
question:
What will come in place of the question mark (?) in the following equation, if ‘+’ and ‘−’ are interchanged and ‘×’ and ‘÷’ are interchanged?

 104 - 176 times 16 div 9 + 192 = ?
solution:
Expression: 104 - 176 times 16 div 9 + 192

Interchange:

+ ↔ −

× ↔ ÷

Apply operator interchange then follow BODMAS

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/e76c5e021ed566a82e88df41d83c17bd34df57a660701655e7f86b467ae372a7.png] 

After interchange:

104 + 176 ÷ 16 × 9 − 
192

First ÷ and ×

176 ÷ 16 = 11

11 × 9 = 99

Now expression:

104 + 99 − 192

104 + 99 = 203

203 − 192 = 11

**∴ Required value = 11.**

Hence the correct answer is **Option 4.**
